entities.name: Amazasp II of Iberia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Amazasp II was a king (mepe) of Iberia and the last in the P'arnavaziani line according to the medieval Georgian chronicles. A son and successor of P'arsman III, he is assumed to have ruled in the latter quarter of the 2nd century, from 185 to 189 according to Cyril Toumanoff.
